# Task creation and modification columns share timestamp display and date sorting

The new columns use creationDate and lastModifiedTime as item properties. Cell text formats valid timestamps in the default timezone and leaves missing/invalid display blank, rather than showing a recurring-task label. Sorting resolves the selected column property to nativeTime and the date_filled comparator, which puts missing dates last independently of direction. No new test or live column/accessibility validation was added.

Scope: Calendar task timestamp columns.
